entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou dwe fè li. Ou pral santi pi bon, plis konfòtab nan pwòp po ou?" t="You should do it. You'll feel so much better, so much more comfortable in your own skin." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou dwe fè li. Ou pral santi pi bon, plis konfòtab nan pwòp po ou?" t="Ar trebui s-o faci. O să te simți mult mai bine, mult mai confortabil în pielea ta." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men, si mwen pa fè sa?" t="But what if I don't?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men, si mwen pa fè sa?" t="Dar dacă nu o fac?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kisa ou vle di? E si ou pa fè sa?" t="What d'you mean, what if you don't?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kisa ou vle di? E si ou pa fè sa?" t="Ce vrei să spui, dacă nu o faci?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwe pa konnen, e - si mwen pa renmen li, kisa?" t="Dunno, I – what if I don't like it? Then what?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwe pa konnen, e - si mwen pa renmen li, kisa?" t="Habar n-am, eu – dacă nu-mi place? Și atunci ce?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kisa ou ap pale laa? Tout moun renmen li?" t="What are you on about? Everyone likes it." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kisa ou ap pale laa? Tout moun renmen li?" t="Despre ce vorbești? Tuturor le place." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men mwen pa tout moun?" t="But I'm not everyone." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Men mwen pa tout moun?" t="Dar eu nu sunt toată lumea." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Vrèman?" t="You don't say." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Vrèman?" t="Nu mi-ai zice!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kisa sa sipoze vle di?" t="What's that s'posed to mean?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Kisa sa sipoze vle di?" t="Ce vrei să spui cu asta?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Egzakteman sa. Ou enposib. Chak ti bagay, li toujou, \"men kisa de sa, e sa?\" Jezi?" t="Exactly that. You're impossible. Every little thing, it's always \"but what about this, what about that.\" Jesus." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Egzakteman sa. Ou enposib. Chak ti bagay, li toujou, \"men kisa de sa, e sa?\" Jezi?" t="Exact asta. Ești imposibilă. La orice fleac, e mereu „dar cu asta ce facem, dar cu aia?”. Doamne." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro_m: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Egzakteman sa. Ou enposib. Chak ti bagay, li toujou, \"men kisa de sa, e sa?\" Jezi?" t="Exact asta. Ești imposibil. La orice fleac, e mereu „dar cu asta ce facem, dar cu aia?”. Doamne." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Um byen, eskiiiiiz'm?" t="Well, soooorry." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Um byen, eskiiiiiz'm?" t="Ei, scuze răăău." b="" a=""/>
